fit: Distinctive new company/marketing pages; one visual system, business-specific page plan and browser finish checks.
avoid: Do not impose a marketing-page layout, full-screen sections, fixed navigation, random font/palette choices or generated imagery on a dashboard or an established brand. Project requirements override house style.
use: Read page-kind guidance and house rules; choose a concrete layout/example and validate the actual output.

sources.locator: House rules; The page plan by kind; The run; Checklist

evidence: documentation reviewed; no independent visual benchmark
